command: set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --prune origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb devices -l; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d ''); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) echo 'Unexpected Android device model' >&2; exit 20;; esac
